notes: Direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF encountered. robots.txt (https://www.fonq.nl/robots.txt) has a generic 'User-agent: *' with many facet-param Disallow lines (SEO noise-URL suppression) but NO Claude-specific disallow (no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web entries) -- proceeded. fonQ is a genuine large Dutch general lifestyle/home marketplace (platform brand 'Etrias', see documents.cdn.etrias.nl legal docs and etrias.nl in structured data) selling furniture, garden, home accessories, lighting, kitchen/dining, sleep, household, bathroom and baby/kids -- only the Home Decor slice was extracted; the rest (furniture, bedding, cookware, cleaning, storage, bathroom hardware, garden furniture) was reviewed and excluded per the brief. COUNT METHOD: every category page is server-rendered (no browser automation used) with a Vue/Algolia-style widget; the visible header 'v-text="nbResults">N artikelen' is baked into the initial HTML (not a placeholder). Verified this is NOT inflated via an exhaustion check: each page also renders a faceted-filter sidebar with per-option product counts embedded as JSON; the 'manufacturer' (brand) facet is single-valued and exhaustive (every product has exactly one brand) so its option-count sum is a true independent total. This sum exactly matched nbResults on 24 of 26 checked categories. Where the manufacturer facet was absent (small categories: Spotjes, Wekker, Poster), a different exhaustive facet (materiaal/vorm) was used instead and also matched exactly. Servies (Tableware) showed a small, stable 3-item variance (header 5853 vs manufacturer-facet sum 5856, reproduced on 2 reads, ~0.05%) -- used the header value per Rule 1 default and flagged the row. RULE 0 GAINS: included Bathroom Lighting (153) and the full Outdoor Lighting branch (Outdoor Table Lamps 244, Bollard/Pedestal Lights 14) that a room-word exclusion would have dropped; included all mirror/clock room variants present (Alarm Clocks alongside Wall/Decorative Clocks). RULE 0.6 OVERLAP: 'Plafondlampen' (Ceiling Lamps, /collections/plafondlampen) was found to be byte-identical in product count AND full brand-facet breakdown to 'Hanglampen' (Pendant Lamps) -- same underlying listing under a second URL/name at the same nav level; kept Hanglampen only and dropped the duplicate. 'Buitenverlichting' (Outdoor Lighting umbrella, 379) and 'Glazen & karaffen' (Glassware umbrella, 2158) and 'Binnenverlichting/Verlichting' (Indoor Lighting umbrella, 4677) are genuine parent/'view all' listing pages whose children (Outdoor Table Lamps+Bollard Lights; Wine+Water Glasses; the 9 lighting-type children) are subsets -- represented as parent grouping rows per the hierarchy contract (no qty on the parent) rather than double-counting. EXCLUDED AS EMPTY (page exists, 0 products at check time, re-confirmed): Kinderverlichting (children's lighting), Solar verlichting (solar garden lighting), Muursticker (wall stickers). EXCLUDED AS MIXED ROLLUPS (inspected actual product titles, dominated by non-decor items, dropped per 'drop them, don't pad'): 'Tuindecoratie' (2397 -- dominated by Madison sierkussens/bankkussens, i.e. cushions/textiles); 'Woondecoratie' (7068 -- superset of Vazen+Kandelaar+Fotolijsten+Ornamenten+Wanddecoratie+Klokken+Posters+Schilderijen+Spiegels and more, a rollup, not its own population); 'Kinderkamer decoratie' (103 -- sampled titles were Plaid/Sprei/Sierkussen, i.e. bedding/textiles); 'Lamponderdelen' (200 -- Type Product facet shows Dimmer/Lampenolie/Lampenvoet/LED-lamp/LED-spot dominate; Lampenkap/lamp-shades is only 126/200 embedded inside it with no separately crawlable URL -- tried ?type_product=lampenkap, confirmed the query param is not applied server-side, still returns all 200, so it cannot be isolated as its own verified leaf). EXCLUDED AS FUNCTIONAL/HARDWARE (checked product titles): 'Wandhaak' (586 -- Tiger-brand stainless steel utility/bathroom hooks, not decorative wall hooks); 'Memoborden'/'Magneetborden' (pinboards/memo boards, functional office/organisation item); 'Kapstokken' (coat racks, furniture); 'Behang' (wallpaper, blanket-excluded); 'Wandkleed' (8 -- Louis de Poortere rug brand, textile wall tapestry/rug); 'Vogelhuisjes' (20 -- Eva Solo/Elho bird feeders and birdhouses, functional garden/animal product, not interior decor); 'Planten'/'Bloemen & Planten' (26 -- sampled titles are explicitly 'Kunstplant'/'Kunstmatige' = artificial/faux plants, blanket-excluded); 'Interieurparfum' (home fragrance, blanket-excluded); 'Sierkussens', 'Plaids', 'Vloerkleden' (textiles, blanket-excluded); all Meubels/Tuinmeubelen/Slapen/Huishouden/Badkameraccessoires-proper furniture, storage, cookware (Pannen/Messen/Koffiemachines/Bakbenodigdheden/Kookgerei/Organizen & bewaren/Keukentextiel), cutlery (Bestek) and bathroom hardware/fixtures/plumbing categories -- reviewed at the mega-nav level and excluded en masse per the brief's standard exclusion list. 'Bestek' (cutlery), 'Servies' kept as Tableware only after confirming via its Type Product facet (Bord/Kom/Koffiekop/Espressokop/Eierdop/Botervloot etc.) that it is genuinely dinnerware, not mixed with cookware. Kandelaar & windlicht (candle HOLDERS, not scented candles) confirmed via product titles (all 'Kandelaar' holder products, e.g. vtwonen Metal Kandelaar) -- kept per the unscented-holder carve-out. Ornamenten (278) sample-checked (Hoptimist figurines, Urban Nature Culture decorative objects) -- genuine decorative figurines/objects, not Christmas/holiday ornaments -- kept. All canonical links are plain https://www.fonq.nl/collections/... origin URLs (verified via on each page); none are proxy/translate/Wayback URLs.
